items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: and see this guy plays with Jimmy Smith -- was playing

ctx.x: -- and see this guy plays with Jimmy Smith -- was playing, he was playing for hours back in the back room there. John took that guitar and came up in the living room and this is where he and I were sitting there. Boy, this is -- the way that he plays, his voicing on there is like a harp.

It's like he's playing a harp only he's faster than a harp, you know, and the way -- you should -- I was looking at the way his fingers were stretched out. This guy plays some hard shit on that guitar. I mean, it is not easy what he's doing. It is not easy. It takes practice, practice, practice, practice and some more practice for what he does on
